steps.label: X0a control: known-good bold + a NONSENSE field alongside it
X0b control: the NONSENSE field ALONE (no known field at all)
A1 borderType FULL_BORDER (the documented candidate name)
B2:C3 OUTER_BORDER over a multi-cell RANGE
B4:C5 INNER_BORDER over a multi-cell RANGE
D2 border FIRST (so the clear has something to clear)
D3 border FIRST, then an EMPTY-STRING borderType clear attempt
D7 borderColor in a BAD form ('red') with a valid borderType
E2:E4 FULL_BORDER over the WHOLE merged span
F2 FULL_BORDER on the merge ANCHOR ONLY (part of the region)
G4 combined: bold + backColor + FULL_BORDER in one style
